Nigel Farage Wins UK By-Election

Nigel Farage has won the Clacton by-election, defeating his main rival Count Binface, a comedian dressed as a trash can. The by-election was boycotted by the UK's main political parties, who described the contest as a farce. Farage's victory was seen as a 'resounding victory' by him, but his opponent claimed a 'moral victory'. The election saw Farage regain his parliamentary seat. The UK's main political parties did not participate in the by-election, which was triggered by Farage himself. Count Binface, who wore a trash can on his head, secured more than a quarter of the vote.
